cats.name: Pussy Cat Club
cats.catName: Boss Cat, the proprietor of the Pussy Cat Club
cats.whoIsTheCat: No real cat. Boss Cat is the made-up owner of the Pussy Cat Club, a nightclub-themed memecoin on Robinhood Chain. He is a chunky brown tabby in black sunglasses and a pink diamond chain who 'runs the door', drawn in photoreal, AI-style art. He arrived with the coin on 25 Aug 2026. The @PussyCatClubRH X account joined the day before.

virality.summary: A young coin with a busy club-night community, not one viral moment. The project posts short Boss Cat skits ('The club installed a snack elevator straight from the kitchen to Boss Cats table') and runs near-daily X Spaces called 'The Pussy Cat Club Live' (#24 was on 25 Sep 2026). Its site has a free meme archive and a PFP maker that 'puts you in the club'. CoinGecko files it under Cat-Themed and Robinhood Chain Meme. Its peak so far came in its first week: about $10M market cap on 31 Aug 2026 (CryptoRank).

Holders: 11,705 (GeckoTerminal, 25 Sep 2026 14:26 UTC). The project posted '11k holders' on 23 Sep and a push for '12k holders' on 24 Sep. 24h volume: $55.9k (CoinGecko, 21:06 UTC). Top 10 holders: 18.8% (GeckoTerminal). Read 2026-09-25 21:08-21:18 UTC (fxtwitter API, GeckoTerminal, CoinGecko, CryptoRank).

coin.endorsedByOwner: Not applicable: Boss Cat is the project's own character, not a real cat or anyone else's IP.

cats.lore: Every club needs someone on the door. At the Pussy Cat Club it is Boss Cat, a big brown tabby in black shades and a pink diamond chain. He has never taken the sunglasses off, and nobody has asked why. He opened the club on Robinhood Chain in August 2026. The house rules are simple: no roadmap, no promises, no dogs. His regulars throw near-daily parties, bring him 'Meowtinis' and send photos from the rooftop at 2 a.m. Boss Cat watches it all from his pink velvet sofa. If you have to ask what's inside, you're not on the list.

look.breed: Domestic shorthair, brown mackerel tabby (photoreal, AI-style character)
look.coat: #7A6558 (brown-grey tabby base), #3B2C25 (dark mackerel stripes and forehead M), #A89890 (lighter ticked fur on cheeks and chest), #D9CDC5 (cream muzzle and chin), #B8877A (pink-brown nose)
look.pattern: Mackerel tabby: narrow dark stripes running down the forehead into an M, swirls on the cheeks, rings across the chest, striped legs and a ringed tail. Paler cream muzzle and chin, long white whiskers.
look.eyes: Hidden behind the sunglasses (the site: 'He has never taken the sunglasses off'). Faint amber eyes show through the dark lenses in the logo.
look.signature: Deadpan bouncer stare: head-on, chin level, mouth in a flat, unimpressed line, a heavy body squared up like the door itself. In the X banner he lounges belly-out on a pink velvet sofa with a martini glass while three kittens in heart sunglasses and feather boas sit beside him.
look.poseHint: Idle: sit broad and upright at the club door, head turning slowly as if checking the list. Click: lean back as if on a sofa and raise one paw. Keep him big and heavy-set (a boss, not a kitten). Leave out the martini glass if the garden should stay family-friendly.
look.wears: Black wayfarer-style sunglasses (#0A0A0A) and a pink crystal Cuban-link chain (#D86AA6) with a large heart-shaped pink gem pendant (#E77FB8, highlights #F6DAEB)

cats.name: nubcat
cats.catName: Nub, the silly blue cat by Leon Karssen
cats.whoIsTheCat: No real cat. Nub is a light-blue cartoon cat drawn in a deliberately rough, MS-Paint-like style by the Dutch illustrator Leon Karssen, who has posted him on Instagram as @sillynubcat since about 2012. Nub 'draws silly things with his silly friends'. He spread as a reaction image in comment sections, and the NUB token launched on Solana in March 2024.

virality.summary: Nub was a meme long before the coin. Leon Karssen's @sillynubcat Instagram had 280K+ followers by May 2025 (Verio) and is now described as having about 1M. Nub's blank, dot-eyed stare became a favourite reaction image in Instagram comments, and fans got Nub tattoos and tees. In April 2024 crypto traders began calling Karssen 'the Matt Furie of Solana', after the NUB token launched that March. Bitget, HTX and AscendEX listed it. In Sept 2026 the community moved to a new contract, and the developer DevGwardo posts new Nub memes daily on X, several above 80,000 views.
virality.metrics: Instagram @sillynubcat: 280K+ followers (Verio on X, 15 May 2025). About 1M per NamuWiki and a search listing of the Instagram page (not read directly: Instagram returned 429). X @DevGwardo (the X link on CoinGecko and Jupiter): 22,853 followers. His top Nub posts on 24 Sep 2026 got 107,769 views and 5,336 likes, and 86,656 views and 3,798 likes. The original @nubcat X account is suspended. '...Leon Karssen has $nub' (@0xBold, 2 Apr 2024): 8,263 views. Holders: 925 on the new contract (GeckoTerminal) and 23,976 on the old one (Jupiter). 24h volume: $149.2k (CoinGecko, 21:06 UTC).

coin.launched: The original token launched in March 2024 on Solana. Its first Raydium nub/SOL pool opened on 2024-03-25 at 02:22 UTC (GeckoTerminal). The current contract was created on 2026-09-18 at 16:48:40 UTC on pump.fun through a 1:1 migrate.fun migration and graduated to PumpSwap in the same second (Jupiter token API; CoinGecko description).
coin.launchpad: pump.fun, via migrate.fun (current contract). No launchpad is recorded for the original March 2024 contract.
coin.endorsedByOwner: No endorsement found. Leon Karssen created Nub, but no statement from him about the NUB token was found. His @LeonKarssen X account is suspended, and neither leonkarssen.com nor the sillynub.com merch shop mentions the coin. Exchange write-ups that name him as the creator are not endorsements.

cats.lore: Nub is a small blue cat with two dot eyes, a tiny mouth and fluffy cheek tufts, drawn in wobbly black lines like a doodle in MS Paint. The Dutch artist Leon Karssen has been drawing him since about 2012. Nub draws silly things with his silly friends and turns up in comment sections whenever a moment needs a blank, loving stare. Fans wear him as tattoos. In 2024 Solana meme-makers gave him a coin. In 2026 the community moved it to a new home and kept the memes coming, often with a pink cat friend at his side.

look.breed: Cartoon cat (flat 2D doodle character, no real breed)
look.coat: #B7D9FF (flat light-blue body), #23282D (thick, wobbly black outline and features), #F7B5C5 (pink inside the open mouth, when shown), #F2A7BE (soft pink cheek blush in some memes)
look.pattern: Solid flat light blue with no markings. Everything is drawn with a thick, slightly wobbly black outline: two pointed ears, little zigzag fur tufts on both cheeks, stubby arms held out to the sides with small claw lines, and a short tail.
look.eyes: Two tiny solid black dots set wide apart (#23282D), with no iris and no highlight
look.signature: The blank, silly Nub stare: dot eyes, a tiny black nose-and-mouth mark between them, arms spread out from the body as if about to hug. Common variants: a tall open mouth with a pink inside (the nub.lol thumbs-up), or eyes squeezed into dashes while hugging a pink friend.
look.poseHint: Build him as a flat toon (cel shading with a thick black outline shader) so he still reads as a doodle in 3D. Idle: stand facing the viewer with arms out, swaying slightly. Click: give one giant thumbs-up (as on nub.lol) or open the mouth into a tall pink O.

cats.name: michi
cats.whoIsTheCat: A real kitten whose name and owner are unknown. It is a fluffy white kitten with grey ears and cap and a smoky tail, filmed standing upright on a wooden floor by some window blinds. No source says who filmed it or where. 'Michi' is Spanish slang for 'kitty'. The image was a meme before it was a coin. The Solana token launched on 8 Apr 2024.

virality.summary: The coin calls michi 'the most memeable cat on the internet' and 'the infinity meme'. Artists paste the standing kitten into costumes of anime heroes, athletes and pop stars, and michi.meme hosts thousands of these edits. In June 2024 Ariana Grande reposted a fan-made michi meme on her Instagram story (Decrypt). The project's timeline also lists shares by Bella Poarch, UFC champion Max Holloway and a LE SSERAFIM member. A Solo Leveling michi post in March 2025 passed 3.1M views. The original token peaked at about $0.59 on 16 May 2024 and was listed on Kraken, MEXC, HTX and Gate, plus Bybit perpetuals. In March 2026 the community moved it to PumpSwap.
virality.metrics: X @michionsolana: 45,600 followers (joined 9 Apr 2024). 'arise #sololeveling' (28 Mar 2025): 3,139,164 views and 90,539 likes. 'michi x ariana grande' (10 Jun 2024): 220,328 views. Daily memes from 16-25 Sep 2026 got 1,092-3,240 views each. Holders: 45,846 on the old contract (Jupiter) and 1,953 on the new one (GeckoTerminal). ATH: $0.5877 on 16 May 2024 for the old token (CoinGecko 'michi [OLD]'; the site says over $300M market cap) and $0.004937 on 25 Aug 2026 for the new contract (CoinGecko). 24h volume: $42.4k (CoinGecko, 21:06 UTC).

coin.launched: The original token launched on 2024-04-08 on Solana (michi.meme timeline). Its first Raydium $michi/SOL pool opened at 04:48 UTC that day (GeckoTerminal). The current contract was created on 2026-03-10 at 21:04:42 UTC on pump.fun via migrate.fun and moved to PumpSwap in the same second (Jupiter). Per michi.meme/migration, the deposit window ran from 24 Feb to 10 Mar 2026 and claims closed on 8 Jun 2026.
coin.launchpad: pump.fun, via migrate.fun (current contract). The original April 2024 contract's launchpad was not checked.
coin.endorsedByOwner: Unknown. The kitten's owner is not identified, and no owner endorsement was found. CoinGecko's text mentions 'Michi's Endorsement', but that is the project's own marketing, not a statement from the owner. Celebrity reposts were of fan memes; Decrypt noted that Ariana Grande likely did not know about the coin.

cats.lore: Somewhere, someone filmed a fluffy kitten standing on its hind legs by the window, paws up, looking faintly surprised. The internet named it michi, Spanish slang for 'kitty', and never let it sit down again. Since then michi has been a ninja, a quarterback, a Solo Leveling hunter and a pop star's love-potion courier. The community calls it 'the infinity meme', because there is a michi for everything. In 2026 its fans moved michi to a new home on Solana and kept drawing, one costume a day.

look.coat: #F5F2EE (white body, chest, belly and paws), #7D746C (warm grey patches over both ears and the crown), #4B433D (dark smoky-grey tail), #E9C9C0 (pale pink nose)
look.pattern: Bicolour 'cap' pattern: mostly white, with grey patches over both ears and the top of the head, split by a white blaze down the forehead. Dark grey tail. Long, fluffy kitten fur, fullest on the chest and cheeks. Small ears with forward-tipped tips.
look.eyes: Dark, round kitten eyes. They read dark grey-brown in the low-resolution clip; the exact colour is unknown.
look.signature: Standing bolt upright on the hind legs with the front paws held up at chest height, head slightly tilted, and a startled, earnest stare. The whole meme is this one pose.
look.poseHint: Always stand upright on the hind legs with paws raised, never on all fours. Idle: a tiny balance wobble and a blink. Click: put on a costume, the way michi memes do, as a toggle. Don't copy any brand logo, jersey or anime character design.
look.wears: none (the kitten wears nothing; the costumes are fan edits)

cats.name: Vibing Cat Coin
cats.catName: Vibing Cat, Anoncoin's cartoon ginger kitten
cats.whoIsTheCat: No real cat. VIBECOIN's Vibing Cat is a cartoon ginger kitten made with Anoncoin's AI image tool when the coin launched on 17 Aug 2025. Its coat fades from orange to pink, it has big amber eyes, and it is pouncing at a feather toy. On X it appears as a golden tabby in pink sunglasses. Despite the name, it is not Minette, the white cat of the 2020 catJAM 'Vibing Cat' meme.

virality.summary: A small mystery coin, not a famous cat. Its bio reads: 'ngl, the Vibing Cat is pure web chaos. nobody knows who launched it, but it's got that big meme energy. r u vibing or what?' It was created on Anoncoin, a Solana launchpad, and graduated to Meteora the same day. The X account posts daily cartoons of the cat vibing: at karaoke, over coffee and a book, on the Moon, and at 'Cookie Planet'. The name borrows the 2020 Vibing Cat / catJAM meme (Minette, a white cat whose head-bob video by Mick Lagi became a famous Twitch emote), but the coin has no link to that cat.

Read 2026-09-25 21:08-21:20 UTC (fxtwitter API, GeckoTerminal, Jupiter, CoinGecko).

coin.endorsedByOwner: Not applicable: the coin's cat is an original AI-made cartoon, not a real cat. It has no connection to Minette (the catJAM cat) or her owners. Anoncoin's page tags the X profiles @elonmusk and @dogeofficialceo; that is a launchpad tagging feature, not an endorsement.

cats.lore: Nobody knows who launched the Vibing Cat, and the cat does not seem to mind. It appeared on Anoncoin on 17 August 2025: a ginger kitten fading to pink, caught mid-pounce at a feather on a string. Since then it has found a pair of pink sunglasses and gone exploring. It has done karaoke, curled up with coffee and a good book, taken a selfie with the Moon and stopped at Cookie Planet on the way. Its motto is simple: don't doubt your vibe. Ask it who it really is, and it just says 'Meeoowww'.
